content.comment_body: I have two [product_name] modules installed on a control panel, each operating equipment in different rooms. I want to set up the LCD Start Screens so it's clear which module belongs to each room, like Room A12 and Room B13. In the Start Screen settings, you can choose between Clock, Input DI, or Menu. Setting unused digital inputs HIGH can be used as a visual hint, but I'd prefer not to do this. I'll handle programming and configuration, and the modules will be installed by a field technician. While labeling is possible, it's not ideal for remote management scenarios. I checked the options for [product_name] expansion modules but didn't find anything that fits this purpose. Would appreciate any suggestions. Thank you, [user_name]
You can add a message in your program that is always displayed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want an easy way to identify [product_name] modules on the LCD Start Screen for remote management and differentiation in various locations. Built-in screen options are limited, and using digital inputs as a workaround is not ideal. A persistent message programmed into the device effectively addresses this need.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a simple solution to display customizable text or identifiers on the LCD Start Screen of [product_name] modules, making it easier to distinguish units by their specific installation locations.
